The hosted TB3 CI runs this review with org credentials, so this is a local pre-flight gap, not a submission blocker.

physics_v3.why_v3: GLM-5.3 passed v2 in 8m13s by faithful transcription of SPEC.md + exhaustive search over 2.54M combos; gpt-oss failed. Stateless per-point physics, however interlocked, is a transcription task. V3 changes the kind of difficulty: (1) stateful route simulation — coolant temperature and battery SoC evolve over 210 one-km substeps and feed back into every later substep (thermal derating of the continuous envelope; voltage sag shrinking the inverter cap), so errors compound and cannot be spot-checked; (2) a towing load case (+450 kg, +0.35 CdA, +0.04 rear CG capped 0.65) re-evaluates grade torque/power, launch (1.6 vs 2.2 m/s^2), tire load and both top-speed checks (105 vs 125 km/h) — a build must close in two vehicles at once; (3) a full unstaged evaluation costs ~1.44 ms/build, so naive exhaustive search over 4,741,632 combos takes ~1.9 h (the whole agent window) — staged pruning is mandatory. Both v2 trial submissions fail v3 (GLM's winner: budget + towing grade_torque; gpt-oss's pick: 5 checks). Design note: ../physics-v3-design.md
